verdict.rationale: Preventing training use is a fair privacy axis for an AI gateway, which could offer zero-data-retention or no-training provider routing. Nothing in the pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or a data-retention policy. Provider-selection controls (order/only/sort) are an adjacent feature and do not establish that the product itself prevents training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
